headline.purpose: The product name in the bar. A map plate’s own name is 1.75rem, with the same tracking and line-height 1.1.

title.purpose: A section on the plate, such as the events that leave the place. Index headings are 0.95rem. Index group names are 0.8rem in Ink Quiet.

body.purpose: Index names, events, and running text. A status aside, only when the badge does not already say it, is 0.85rem in Ink Quiet.

label.purpose: The status word and the spec extension. Broken and Unreliable are 700. Outcome badges are 0.75rem.

mono.purpose: Code and file names, not titles.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: The place plate, the recorded-test plate, and the map plate.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: The full screen frame inside a plate.

shadows.name: pop
shadows.purpose: The issues drawer. Its scrim is rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.18).

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Map screens, the map legend, and map zoom controls. Map only.

motion.name: fade
motion.purpose: Default transition duration. 0ms when reduced motion is requested.

components.css: .ds-plate { background: var(--card); color: var(--ink); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(28, 36, 48, 0.04), 0 8px 18px rgba(28, 36, 48, 0.05); padding: 28px 32px 48px; margin: 16px; font-family: var(--font); line-height: 1.45; } .ds-plate-title { margin: 0; font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 2.4vw, 2.25rem); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1.05; } .ds-lead { margin: 0.6rem 0 0; color: var(--ink-2); } .ds-event { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; } .ds-event span:last-child { color: var(--muted); } .ds-event:hover { background: var(--bg); } .ds-event:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-event-failed, .ds-event-failed span { color: var(--failed); font-weight: 700; }

components.css: .ds-moment { background: var(--card); color: var(--ink); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(28, 36, 48, 0.04), 0 8px 18px rgba(28, 36, 48, 0.05); padding: 28px 32px 48px; margin: 16px; font-family: var(--font); line-height: 1.45; } .ds-plate-title { margin: 0; font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 2.4vw, 2.25rem); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1.05; } .ds-moment-split { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.4fr) minmax(14rem, 22rem); gap: 1.5rem; align-items: start; margin-top: 1rem; } .ds-moment-mark { margin: 0; font-size: clamp(1.35rem, 2.2vw, 1.75rem); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-moment-mark[data-status="failed"] { color: var(--failed); } .ds-steps { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-step { width: 100%; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: inherit; text-align: left; padding: 0.55rem 0.75rem; min-height: 2.5rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-step:hover { background: var(--bg-2); } .ds-step:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-step-failed { color: var(--failed); font-weight: 700; } .ds-step-current, .ds-step-current:hover { background: var(--place); color: #fff; } .ds-step-failed.ds-step-current, .ds-step-failed.ds-step-current:hover { background: var(--failed); color: #fff; } @media (max-width: 800px) { .ds-moment-split { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

components.css: .ds-badges { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; font-family: var(--font); } .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; border-radius: var(--pill); padding: 0.15rem 0.6rem; background: #eef2f7; color: var(--muted); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-dot { width: 0.6rem; height: 0.6rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--faint); display: inline-block; } .ds-badge[data-status="passed"] { background: var(--passed-soft); color: var(--passed-ink); } .ds-badge[data-status="passed"] .ds-dot { background: var(--passed); } .ds-badge[data-status="failed"] { background: var(--failed-soft); color: var(--failed-ink); } .ds-badge[data-status="failed"] .ds-dot { background: var(--failed); } .ds-badge[data-status="flaky"] { background: var(--flaky-soft); color: var(--flaky-ink); } .ds-badge[data-status="flaky"] .ds-dot { background: var(--flaky); } .ds-badge[data-status="not-reached"] { background: var(--bg); color: var(--muted); border: 1px dashed var(--line-2); } .ds-badge[data-status="not-reached"] .ds-dot { background: transparent; border: 1.5px dashed var(--faint); }

narrative.overview:
Atlas is a gazetteer of a recorded run. The index stays open, and one white plate shows the place you opened: its name in large type, its screen, and the events that leave it. Choosing a place, a spec, or a recorded moment replaces only that plate. The index does not move.

A spec of any kind is another index row, the filename and its extension, not a second kind of page. A recorded test is the same plate: the moment large, the steps beside it. The ground is a cool gray-blue. The plate is a white sheet. Place blue is reserved for where you are: the bar, the current row, the current step, links, and the focus ring.

Ink is the reading color. Failure red marks only a failed place, event, or moment. Unreliable is a separate brown and is never redrawn as that red. Type is one self-hosted face, Atkinson Hyperlegible, at 400 and 700. The reading is quiet. The chosen row is the loudest thing on the page.
keyCharacteristics: The index stays open beside one white plate
Place blue marks where you are
Status is a word on the right of the row
Failure and unreliable are different colors
At 760px the document scrolls, sheet first

rules.name: The Place Blue Rule
rules.body: Place blue is the header, the current index row, the current moment step, links, and the focus ring. It marks where you are. It is not a tint for decoration.

rules.name: The Status Word Rule
rules.body: The index states the outcome in words on the right. Only Broken and Unreliable are colored, in Failure and Unreliable. Every other status word is Ink Quiet. The current row is Place Blue with white text, and the status word turns white with it.

rules.name: The Map Kind Rule
rules.body: User, system, time, and hand-off colors are for the map legend and map edges. On the plate, an event is ink, and a failed event is Failure. The plate does not color an event by kind.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Atkinson Hyperlegible, self-hosted, at 400 and 700, is the only text face. Monospace is for code and file names, not for titles.

rules.name: The Plate Title Rule
rules.body: The open place, spec, or moment is set at clamp(1.75rem, 2.4vw, 2.25rem), weight 700, letter-spacing -0.03em, line-height 1.05.

rules.name: The Open Index Rule
rules.body: The index stays open. Choosing a place, a spec, or a recorded moment replaces only the plate.

rules.name: The Narrow Document Rule
rules.body: At 760px the document scrolls. The sheet leads. The index follows.

rules.name: The One Sheet Rule
rules.body: Depth is one white plate lifted off the ground. Its shadow is 0 1px 2px rgba(28, 36, 48, 0.04), 0 8px 18px rgba(28, 36, 48, 0.05). Places are not a card grid.

rules.name: The Two Radii Rule
rules.body: The plate is a 16px sheet. Index rows, the search field, and the run picker are 8px. Pills are for outcome badges, not for the plate or the index.

dos: Do keep the index open. Choosing a place, a spec, or a recorded moment replaces only the plate.
Do set the plate title at clamp(1.75rem, 2.4vw, 2.25rem), weight 700, letter-spacing -0.03em, line-height 1.05.

Do put the status word on the right of the index row. Broken is Failure at weight 700. Unreliable is Unreliable at weight 700. Any other status word is Ink Quiet. The current row is Place Blue with white text, status word included.
Do draw the plate as a white sheet with a 16px radius and the shadow 0 1px 2px rgba(28, 36, 48, 0.04), 0 8px 18px rgba(28, 36, 48, 0.05).
Do at 760px, scroll the document. The sheet leads. The index follows.
Do show a spec as an index row, filename and extension, and a recorded test as the same plate: the moment large, the steps beside it.
donts: Don't replace the index and the plate with a card grid.
Don't send a spec or a recorded test to a detached page.
Don't paint an unreliable result with Failure red.
Don't set titles in a second display face. Atkinson Hyperlegible at 400 and 700 is the text face. Monospace is for code and file names.
